info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Pricings-v4-spec
info.description: The Hotel Room Pricing API enables users to access real-time pricing information for available hotel rooms. It provides essential data such as current rates, availability, and pricing structure to facilitate decision-making for travelers and hotel managers alike. This API is particularly useful for booking platforms and tour operators seeking to display competitive pricing to their customers. By leveraging this endpoint, consumers can ensure they are providing the most accurate and up-to-date hotel room pricing information.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the pricing information for available rooms. It provides the necessary data to help users understand the costs associated with different room options.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving pricing information for rooms. It should contain the necessary parameters to filter or specify the pricing details required.

200.description: The request was successful, returning the room pricing details.
